blocked.reason: page shows 'Please prove that you are human' challenge; rendered fetch timed out; not pursued

notes: The international admission guide (eligibility, English score minimums, documents) is published only as a PDF embedded in https://adm-g.postech.ac.kr/ENG/admission/gist/ (file '[Graduate School]26-27 Admissions Guide for International Students_2nd round.pdf'), so IELTS/TOEFL minimums and degree eligibility could not be quoted; they remain unrecorded. The English-score table found in HTML (Mechanical Engineering Korean page, exemption table TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.0) lists a table without a verbatim-quotable row and the page heads only integrated MS-PhD and PhD admissions, so it was not used. Application windows on the official schedule (2026-27 round 1: 2026-02-24 to 2026-04-03; round 2: 2026-07-06 to 2026-09-11) are already closed and the 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30 'International Application - 3rd' entry is labelled 'sysyem test (DO NOT APPLY)', so no deadline is recorded. The English page of the EEE department is titled 2025-26, so the Korean ee.postech.ac.kr page (2026-2027) was cited instead. CSE, IME pages only point to the central PDF prospectus. Many programmes are integrated MS-PhD; no master's-only list is published in HTML.
